When plumbing emergencies strike in Buffalo, knowing when to call an emergency plumber can save you thousands in property damage. At Buffalo Plumbing PROS, we understand that Western New York's extreme weather conditions can wreak havoc on your plumbing system. Here's your definitive guide to recognizing genuine plumbing emergencies.

What Qualifies as a Plumbing Emergency in Buffalo?

Not every plumbing issue requires immediate attention, but certain situations demand professional intervention right away, especially in areas like North Buffalo and West Side where older homes are common.

1. Burst or Frozen Pipes

Buffalo's harsh winters can cause pipes to freeze and burst, leading to immediate flooding. Signs include:

  • Water spraying from pipes
  • Unusual sounds in your plumbing system
  • Sudden drop in water pressure
  • Water stains on walls or ceilings

2. Sewage Backup

If you notice sewage backing up through drains or toilets, don't wait. This health hazard requires immediate attention from our toilet repair specialists.

3. No Hot Water in Winter

During Buffalo's cold months, losing hot water isn't just inconvenient—it's dangerous. Our water heater repair experts provide 24/7 emergency service.

4. Major Sink or Faucet Issues

While minor drips can wait, significant leaks require immediate faucet repair or replacement to prevent water damage and waste.

5. Flooding Basements

Common in Elmwood Village during spring thaws, flooding basements need immediate professional attention to prevent structural damage.
